sources.fact: 37,666 records from 354 providers; collector 23 July 2026, new data 22 July 2026, all data from authoritative sources.
Experimental boundary dataset has 2,916 records from 5 providers; MHCLG-created and expected to be combined later with brownfield land.
Title-boundary dataset has 2,595,903 records from one provider; platform says it includes some MHCLG-created data and is not a substitute for current HMLR title evidence.
Planning application dataset has 100,627 records from 6 providers; collector/new data date is 17 September 2025 and origin is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
5,305 condition records from one provider; MHCLG-created and not borough-complete.
Planning application status dataset currently has zero records/providers, so absence cannot prove an application state.
Controlled brownfield permission values are permissioned, not-permissioned and pending-decision.
Controlled ownership values include public, non-public, mixed and unknown ownership; unknown is preserved rather than filled.
11,007 conservation areas from 158 providers; platform explicitly says the dataset is incomplete and contains duplicates being reconciled.
7,152 Article 4 direction areas from 111 providers; coverage is growing and mixed-origin.
107,674 TPO records from 74 providers; collector/new data 24 July 2026 with mixed-origin caveat.
364 local-plan boundaries from one provider; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.

examples.result: Brownfield point geometry is not converted into a site polygon or exact parcel relation.
Experimental brownfield-site absence is not negative evidence because coverage is only five providers.
Planning-application platform coverage is not treated as a complete borough application register.
Zero-record planning-application-status dataset cannot be used to assign current status.
Conservation-area or Article 4 absence is not treated as no constraint where platform coverage is incomplete.
Controlled permission/ownership categories are retained exactly; unknown values are not imputed.
Title-boundary platform geometry is cross-check evidence only until current HMLR title relation is verified.
No candidate promotion occurs from Planning Data alone without exact site polygon, exact parcel binding and current statutory/application evidence.
